A person, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log. Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap."
